Hi all — took a look. Summary and supporting calc below.

Assumptions (please confirm):
- Current seats: 12
- Requested seats: 18 (additional = 6)
- Monthly list price per seat: $200 USD/mo (customer on published seat tier)
- Billing cycle: Feb 1 – Feb 28 (28 days)
- Requested effective date: Feb 20 (change applied today)

Proration math (pro-rated charge for additional seats for Feb remainder):
- Days remaining in cycle (including Feb 20): 9 days (20–28)
- Prorate factor = 9 / 28 = 0.3214286
- Monthly cost for 6 seats = 6 * $200 = $1,200.00
- Prorated charge = $1,200 * 0.3214286 = $385.71 (rounded to cents)

Options for billing flow:
A) Immediate pro-forma invoice for $385.71 (posted to your billing portal). Payment can be made immediately or via netting against March invoice — we can issue a debit memo and then offset it on March's invoice.
B) Skip immediate charge and roll the $385.71 onto the March invoice as a line item (netting). This will be reflected as an interim prorate line and the March invoice total will include both the prorated Feb add-on and the normal March subscription.

VAT handling (EU B2B, DE):
- If Orion provides a valid EU VAT ID, we can apply reverse-charge (0% VAT) on our invoice and include the VAT ID and the reverse-charge note. If no VAT ID is provided, local VAT at the applicable rate (DE VAT) would be applied. Please provide the VAT ID to ensure correct treatment.

Attachments: I generated a pro-forma showing the $385.71 prorated line and an updated invoice preview. Files attached: 20260223_proforma_orion_prorate.pdf (pro-forma) and invoice_0001234.pdf (preview of March with optional netting line).

Next steps:
- Thomas / Orion finance: confirm VAT ID and whether you want option A (immediate pro-forma + payment) or option B (net to March).
- Neha / Marissa: if client wants netting, I'll create a debit memo and update March invoice; if immediate, I'll mark pro-forma payable and send payment link.

Let me know and I'll take care of the invoice flow.

Thanks,
